title: Lake Falathim
wikitext:
[[File:Lake Falathim.jpg|thumb|Lake Falathim]]
'''Lake Falathim''' is located in western [[Ashenvale]], southeast of [[the Zoram Strand]] and southwest of [[Maestra's Post]]. Although it was once a popular place for [[night elves]] to go swim or fish, the lake has recently become overrun with ferocious [[murloc]]s. The scholar [[Teronis' Corpse|Teronis]] was last seen near the lake, it bodes ill of his fate that he has not yet returned.
